Invariant: Window has aware start/end and start < end
Limit: Does not establish a clinic-approved window policy

Invariant: Appointment state and check-in/no-show timestamps are coherent
Violating example: CHECKED_IN without checked_in_at; NO_SHOW with accepted check-in
Limit: Limited to fields in reference model

Invariant: An appointment has no more than one active queue ticket
Valid example: One WAITING ticket for an accepted check-in
Violating example: Two WAITING/CALLED tickets for same appointment

Invariant: Ticket issuance requires accepted check-in and no active ticket
Valid example: CHECKED_IN appointment with no existing active ticket
Violating example: Create ticket for CONFIRMED appointment or create duplicate active ticket
Limit: Reference guard is not a transactional database guarantee

Invariant: No-show requires confirmed state, no check-in, expired grace, authorised role
Violating example: Patient role or attempt before threshold
Limit: Role list and threshold need clinic approval

Invariant: Queue state transitions follow the allowed transition graph
Limit: Does not model every clinic exception
